parity_gaps: textShadow: PreviewCanvas hardcodes text-shadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)', whereas FFmpeg drawtext has no shadow
background_opacity: PreviewCanvas applies backgroundColor directly without opacity when hex is #RRGGBB, whereas FFmpeg uses boxcolor@opacity
padding: PreviewCanvas sets padding_x and padding_y independently, whereas FFmpeg merges them into uniform boxborderw = max(padding_x, padding_y)
accent_color: Defined in domain TextStyle, but omitted in both PreviewCanvas and FFmpeg filtergraph
typography_fallback: FFmpeg export hardcodes C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf, completely ignoring font_family, font_weight, line_height, and text alignment
